ValidationRule.description: Cannot move backwards in opportunity stages. Applies to Agency opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (CASE( StageName , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Quote",4, "Negotiation",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0) < CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Quote",4, "Negotiation",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)) && RecordTypeId = "0121a000000EqqS" && $User.ProfileId <>"00e1a000000lWln"
